library_preparation_preflight.summary: Meaningful coverage requires a real SQL Server and its separate JDBC driver.

deterministic_setup.reason: flyway-sqlserver does not provide the JDBC driver transitively; Flyway documents it as a separate dependency. The existing test already resolves this driver.
SQL Server-specific Flyway behavior cannot be meaningfully exercised against an embedded database; reuse the existing pinned SQL Server image.

library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Start SQL Server with EULA acceptance and a strong SA password, wait for readiness on port 1433, and configure the JDBC URL, database, username, and password consistently for JVM and native tests. Preserve -H:+AddAllCharsets because the SQL Server driver selects code pages from server collation.
risks: The reported failure already occurs after native-image creation and already includes -H:+AddAllCharsets; setup alone will not fix the runtime metadata failure.
Container startup timing and SQL Server authentication may make tests flaky without an explicit readiness wait.
